milestones.title: The daily signature watch (48.1-14) detects a second manifest signature
The authorizing official accepts the residual risk, or a manifest signer outside the cluster's administration is designed

remediation: Signing is restricted to the archive job's account, but a cluster administrator could sign that day's manifest; a day already archived on write-once storage cannot be changed. Detect a second signature with the daily signature watch, then record the authorizing official's acceptance of the residual risk, or design a manifest signer outside the cluster's administration.
title: A cluster administrator can sign the current day's audit archive manifest
